title: Trade Marketing Leader
description:
About the job

Summary:

Lead and oversee trade marketing efforts across all channels, including retail partners, by developing strategies to drive sell-out and expand the company's channel footprint. This role includes designing high-impact promotional campaigns, managing trade spend budgets, leading promoter field teams, and implementing shop-in-shop modules to enhance point-of-sale (POS) conversion rates.




Responsibilities & Objectives:

• New Product Introductions (NPI) & Displays: Oversee trade launch preparations for high value appliances, handling the full development of premium shop-in-shop displays, demo stations, planograms, and promotional assets.

• Trade Spend & Promotional ROI: Manage, monitor, and improve the promotional budget. Design and assess promotional bundles, trade-in offers, and seasonal campaigns (such as Buen Fin and Mother’s Day) to boost volume while maintaining margins.

• Field Force & Promoter Management: Develop incentive plans, KPI systems, and training programs for field promoters, brand advocates, and RSAs to enhance sell-out efficiency.

• Joint Business Planning (JBP) & Account Support: Collaborate with Sales on business presentations, floor-space negotiations, and customized promotional schedules for key clients.

• Budget Management: Develop, control, and oversee the Trade Marketing budget.

• Promoter Targets & Follow-up: Set sell-out goals per customer and monitor coverage.

• Sales Floor Enhancement: Improve product displays and communication efforts on the sales floor, coordinating with marketing for messaging.

• POP and Display: Develop and distribute POS materials, plan and negotiate special exhibitions and events, and organize sell-out acceleration activities.

• Promotional Communication: Ensure accurate promotion messaging on the sales floor.

• Giveaways: Secure promotional giveaway materials.

• Training: Provide training for promoters and sales staff, coordinating content development and follow-up activities.

• Event Coverage: Manage attendance at customers’ events and dealer expo coverage.

• Expenses and Reimbursements: Track and report quarterly sales floor activities and expenses for reimbursement; handle supplier invoice payments.




Experience & Background

3-5 years of work experience in a similar role in trade marketing, particularly in Consumer Electronics, Home Appliances, or high-involvement durable goods sectors.

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field, with supervisory experience and advanced English skills.




Knowledge, Skills, Abilities 

• Appliance Retail Dynamics: Deep understanding of key retail channels (Consumer Electronics, Home Improvement, Department Stores, Direct-to-Consumer) and their floor share and margin expectations.

• Product Life Cycle & NPI (New Product Introduction): Mastery of launching complex, high ticket appliances, coordinating display floor readiness, sample seeding, and trade launch roadshows.

• Retailer Business Models & Trade Terms: Knowledge of sell-in vs. sell-out dynamics, joint business planning (JBP), cooperative advertising, display allowances, and floor-space negotiations.

• Shopper Journey & In-Store Experience: Expertise in high-involvement purchase paths, category management, demo station placement, and digital-physical (phygital) integration at POS.

Skills

• Promotional & Trade Spend Optimization: Designing, evaluating, and managing high-value promotional campaigns (e.g., promotional bundles, trade-in programs, seasonal peak activations) to protect gross margins.

• Promoter & Field Team Management: Designing incentive structures, training programs, and KPI tracking models for field promoters, brand advocates, and floor sales specialists (RSA - Retail Sales Associates).

• POSM & Floor Display Execution: Managing end-to-end development of premium branded shop-in-shop modules, interactive product displays, high-impact POP materials, and planograms.

• Commercial Analytics and Cross-Functional Synergy: Using sell-out data, inventory turn rates, promoter productivity metrics, and competitor share-of-shelf analysis to dynamically adjust trade plans.

• Major medical insurance, Food Vauchers and more.

description:
About the job

Responsibilities
Team Intro
The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.
With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

We are looking for a passionate and strategic Creator Manager to join our team. You will be responsible for discovering, incubating, and educating e-commerce creators, with a focus on helping vertical creators improve their sales performance. You will collaborate closely with industry teams to match high-potential creators with quality content formats, including short videos and live streaming. Additionally, you will support major campaigns, marketing initiatives, and creator education efforts by providing relevant content and guidance. A key part of your role will be working with the content moderation team to educate creators on platform policies and ensure compliance. 

Responsibilities: 
- Identify, onboard, and incubate e-commerce creators within specific verticals to drive sales growth. 
- Develop and implement strategies to scale creator success, leveraging data insights to guide decision-making. 
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Category, Marketing, Campaign operations) to match creators with suitable content opportunities and promotional activities. 
- Provide ongoing education and support to creators, helping them optimize content strategy, understand platform rules, and improve performance. 
- Work with the content moderation team to ensure creators adhere to platform guidelines and policies.

Qualifications

- Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable plans. 
- Service-oriented mindset, patience, and excellent communication skills to support and educate creators. 
- Fast learner who can quickly absorb information and effectively teach others. 
- Team player with a strong sense of responsibility and a positive, can-do attitude. 
- Proficient in data analysis and comfortable using metrics to drive decisions. 
 
Preferred Qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience in operations or partner management

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. About the job

About You:

Are you interested in launching or growing your career in digital marketing? The WITHIN team is expanding, and we’re looking for a Digital Media Buyer Trainee to support our efforts across multiple marketing channels. This role offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience and develop expertise in key areas of digital marketing, including Paid Social, Paid Search, Programmatic, Email Marketing, Affiliate Marketing, Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Influencer Marketing, and Retail Media.

As part of a fast-growing company, you’ll collaborate with internal teams and clients to drive performance-driven marketing strategies. This role is perfect for individuals who are analytical, creative, and eager to learn in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment.

What You’ll Learn:

This role will expose you to various marketing channels, helping you develop a strong foundation in performance marketing. Depending on the projects you work on, you may gain experience and training in:

Paid Social: Learn how to create and manage paid social campaigns on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn, focusing on targeting, budgeting, and performance analysis to drive engagement and conversions.
Paid Search: Understand how to create and optimize paid search campaigns on platforms like Google Ads and Bing, including keyword research, ad copywriting, and bidding strategies to maximize return on investment (ROI).
Programmatic: Gain insight into programmatic advertising, including working with demand-side platforms (DSPs) to buy display, video, and native ads at scale, optimizing for reach, engagement, and conversions.
Email Marketing: Learn how to craft compelling email campaigns, segment audiences, and optimize performance through testing and automation.
Affiliate Marketing: Understand how brands collaborate with partners to drive traffic and conversions through commission-based strategies.
Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Gain insights into optimizing website content and structure to improve search engine rankings and organic visibility.
Influencer Marketing: Explore how brands collaborate with influencers to build awareness, drive engagement, and generate conversions.
Retail Media: Discover how brands advertise on e-commerce platforms (e.g., Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, etc.) to increase product visibility and sales.




Some duties will include and are definitely not limited to:

Work with a diverse portfolio of clients to support their marketing efforts.
Communicate with clients via email and meetings, ensuring alignment on strategy and performance goals.
Collaborate with multiple internal teams to design and execute marketing strategies.
Produce meaningful marketing KPI dashboards and deliver performance reports with actionable insights.
Support A/B testing, consumer research, and data-driven decision-making to enhance campaign performance.
Assist in implementing best practices and proprietary technology to optimize marketing strategies.
Provide creative and copy recommendations.




Qualifications and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Interest in pursuing a career in performance-driven digital marketing.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel (e.g., conditional statements, pivot tables, VLOOKUPs).
Full professional proficiency (written and spoken) in English.

Our interview process includes, but is not limited to, the following:

Cognitive Aptitude and Typing Test
Logic assessment on Basic data analytics & problem-solving assessment

2-Month Paid Development & Probation Program

This role begins with a 2-month program designed to provide hands-on training and professional working experience, as well as serve as the standard employment probationary period. During this probationary period, you will be closely supervised by our staff and continuously assessed by to determine if you are competent and trustworthy enough to be a full Digital Media Buyer for WITHIN. Upon successful completion of this program, you will be staffed on a team to begin working on client accounts on an independent full-time basis immediately!

Note: Employment types may vary by country due to local labor laws, HR will clarify before employees start.




We offer a competitive salary and benefits based on ability level, including:

Base salary - 25k MXN monthly
Unlimited vacation policy
Health insurance coverage
Food stipend
Internet/phone stipend
Dog friendly office

This is a fully in-office role based in Mexico City, Mexico. Candidates must be available to work on-site five days a week.

WITHIN is the world's first Performance Branding company, partnering with some of the biggest brands in the world to drive business growth through innovative marketing strategies. Our integrated operating model collapses the traditional marketing silos between creative and media, performance and brand, and across media channels. With a full suite of offerings including media, creative, SEO, Lifecycle, Retail Media, Affiliate and Influencer, we’re able to work with our brand partners in an integrated fashion, allowing us to align marketing strategies back to core business objectives. title: Team Lead, Agency Growth Sales, SpLATAM - Mexico
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
At TikTok, our Global Business Solutions (GBS) team plays a key role in generating revenue by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding new clients, driving ad campaigns, and more. As the TikTok community grows at an unprecedented speed around the world, our GBS team leads groundbreaking projects that are changing the landscape of the advertising industry in real time.

About the team:
TikTok's Agency Sales team is at the forefront of connecting agencies of all sizes with TikTok's creative ecosystem — helping them unlock performance, build compelling narratives for their clients, and grow sustainably on the platform. Our team operates at the intersection of business strategy, product expertise, and client partnership.

The LATAM Agency team is a high-growth, high-impact environment where no two days are the same. We move fast, think big, and win together.

About the role:
We are looking for an experienced Team Lead to head our Agency Sales function across Latin America. This is a player-coach role: you will manage and mentor a team of Agency Partner Managers while also owning strategic relationships with our most critical agency partners in the region.

You will be responsible for driving revenue growth, developing the agency ecosystem, and representing TikTok as the go-to performance and brand-building platform for agencies across Brazil & SpLATAM markets including Mexico, Colombia, Argentina. You will be a key voice in shaping regional strategy, go-to-market motions, and long-term agency enablement programs.

This role requires an experience leader with deep knowledge of the LATAM agency landscape, a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, and the ability to inspire and develop high-performing teams in a hyper-growth environment.

In-Office Policy - We are currently working in the office 4x a week in Polanco and will be moving to full-time, 5 days in-office by September 2026.

*Please submit your resume in English in order to be considered*

Responsibilities:
1) Team Leadership & People Development
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of Agency Partner Managers across region, fostering a high-performance culture rooted in accountability, creativity, and commercial rigor.
- Set clear team objectives, track performance against KPIs, and provide structured feedback and development plans to support individual growth.
- Recruit, onboard, and retain top commercial talent as the team scales.
- Serve as a role model for consultative selling, strategic account management, and cross-functional collaboration.

2) Revenue & Business Growth
- Own and drive the team's revenue targets across the SMB agency segment in LATAM, with accountability for both top-line growth and portfolio health metrics.
- Identify, prioritize, and develop strategic agency partnerships — including independent agencies, regional networks, and in-market holding company affiliates.
- Architect and execute scaled engagement models that allow the team to grow agency revenue efficiently across a large and diverse book of business.
- Build and manage a robust pipeline of new agency acquisition opportunities, translating market trends into actionable growth strategies.

3) Agency Partnerships & Enablement
- Build deep, strategic relationships with C-level and high-level stakeholders at top agencies 
- Lead executive business reviews (QBRs) and joint business planning sessions with key agency partners to align on growth roadmaps and investment strategies.
- Develop and oversee structured agency education and certification programs, ensuring partners are fluent in TikTok product solutions, creative best practices, and full-funnel strategies.
- Champion TikTok's value proposition externally, representing the platform at industry events, agency summits, and partner forums across the region.

4) Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence
- Serve as the primary voice-of-the-market for LATAM agency insights, providing structured feedback to Product, Marketing, and Operations to shape platform priorities and scaled solutions.
- Partner closely with cross-functional teams including Global Sales Excellence, Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Ops to design and execute regional go-to-market initiatives.
- Develop data-driven strategic narratives and market analysis to inform leadership decisions and regional investment priorities.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Years of experience in digital advertising, media sales, or agency partnerships, with at least 3 years in a team leadership or management role.
- Deep, firsthand knowledge of the LATAM agency ecosystem — including the leading independent agencies, regional holding company structures, and the key decision-makers shaping client investment across major markets.
- Demonstrated track record of exceeding revenue targets and growing complex, multi-stakeholder agency relationships in a fast-paced commercial environment.
- Proven ability to coach and develop commercial talent, with experience building and scaling high-performing sales teams.
- High written and oral proficiency in Spanish and English is required due to frequent communications with stakeholders based in Spanish-speaking markets".
- Strong command of the digital advertising ecosystem — including performance marketing, programmatic, social, and full-funnel planning — with the ability to credibly advise high-level agency leaders.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience at a social media, digital platform, or ad tech company, ideally working directly with or within agencies at a leadership level.
- Familiarity with TikTok's advertising solutions, including TikTok for Business, Shop Ads, and performance-based products.
- Knowledge of auction-based and programmatic ad products, and experience translating product complexity into commercial narratives for agency audiences.
- Experience designing and leading scaled agency enablement programs such as certification tracks, partner academies, or structured QBR frameworks.
- Strong executive presence with the ability to engage C-suite stakeholders both externally (agency partners) and internally (TikTok leadership).
- Passion for TikTok's mission and a genuine curiosity about creator culture, short-form content trends, and the evolving role of social commerce in LATAM.
- Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable building from the ground up, iterating quickly, and driving clarity in ambiguous, high-growth environments.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

About the job

Company Description CMF Global, Inc. is a California-based manufacturer and supplier of pipes, valves, and fittings for a wide range of global applications, and also provides micro- and mini-hydroelectric power generating equipment. The company owns several sustainable branded products, including AquaFuse, ControlFlo, and AquaFuse Liner, which are specified on major infrastructure projects worldwide. CMF Global specializes in international consolidation and shipping, helping customers streamline procurement and reduce total costs. CMF Global has been recognized with regional Exporter of the Year awards and holds multiple Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) and Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) certifications. 

SUMMARY

The International Sales Support Specialist provides administrative, technical, customer service, and business development support for CMF Global's international sales efforts. This role works closely with the VP of Sales & Marketing, international distributors, contractors, consultants, and internal departments to support sales growth, improve customer experience, coordinate project activities, and strengthen CMF Global's international market presence.




The position is designed to support and enhance international sales activities, allowing senior sales personnel to focus on business development, relationship management, and strategic growth initiatives.




Role Description the International Sales Support Specialist is a full-time remote role responsible for supporting global sales activities and customer accounts. This role assists with coordinating international orders, documentation, and shipping logistics to ensure accurate and timely deliveries. The specialist responds to customer inquiries, prepares quotations, maintains sales records, and supports export financing processes in collaboration with internal teams. Daily tasks include communicating with international clients, distributors, and partners, tracking order status, and resolving issues related to products, pricing, and delivery. The role also involves collaborating with sales and operations teams to improve processes, support bid and proposal preparation, and contribute to a positive customer experience across international markets.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES The following are essential duties and responsibilities of the position; this list is not exhaustive and may include other tasks as assigned:




International Sales Support

Support international distributors, contractors, consultants, and customers with sales-related activities and inquiries.
Assist with the preparation, coordination, and delivery of international quotations and project proposals.
Coordinate with the Quotes and Estimating Team to ensure quotations are accurate, complete, and delivered on a timely basis.
Track outstanding quotations, project opportunities, and lead follow-up and communication activities.

description:
About the job

About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

Crunchyroll, LLC is an independently operated joint venture between US-based Sony Pictures Entertainment, and Japan's Aniplex, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc., both subsidiaries of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation.

About The Role

In the role of Strategic Sourcing Manager, Technology, you will report to the Director, Strategic Sourcing.

We are considering applicants for Mexico City, Mexico.

This role owns a complex, loosely scoped technology sourcing portfolio across cloud infrastructure, content delivery networks, hosting and bandwidth, SaaS, developer tools, observability, customer support platforms, information technology hardware/software, security, and technology services. You will receive strategic objectives and translate them into category strategies, sourcing methods, evaluation criteria, governance routines, and supplier decisions that support Product & Engineering, Enterprise Technology, Information Technology, Security, Finance, Legal, and Accounts Payable. This is an individual-contributor role where impact comes through category ownership, independent judgment, and influential cross-functional execution rather than direct people management. Success in the first year will include a technology sourcing roadmap, stronger renewal discipline, improved contract and purchase-order coverage, and a regular operating cadence for supplier performance.

Core Areas of Responsibility


Define and execute the technology category strategy, including supplier segmentation, spend baselining, renewal planning, and multi-year sourcing roadmaps across engineering, product, enterprise technology, and information technology needs.
Lead complex sourcing events, supplier selection, commercial negotiations, and contract/SOW/order-form reviews where technical, security, legal, finance, and business requirements must be evaluated together.
Determine the methods, process, evaluation criteria, and stakeholder decision path for new or ambiguous technology sourcing assignments, adapting sourcing techniques to the needs of each category and supplier situation.
Improve sourcing governance and controls by partnering with business stakeholders, Finance, Legal, Security, and Accounts Payable to reduce non-PO purchasing, standardize intake, and improve contract and approval discipline.
Create practical supplier-management playbooks for renewals, business reviews, usage and service-level analysis, risk escalation, cost optimization, payment terms, and service continuity.
Turn invoice, contract, usage, and supplier-performance data into recommendations that influence stakeholder decisions and support delivery of tactical business targets.


About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...


You have 5+ years of strategic sourcing, category management, procurement, or vendor-management experience, including 4+ years supporting technology categories.
You have led RFx events, supplier selection, commercial negotiations, and contract reviews for software subscriptions, cloud or infrastructure services, technical services, outsourced support, or managed-service providers.
You understand common technology commercial models, including SaaS subscription terms, cloud or consumption-based pricing, service-level agreements, support terms, renewal mechanics, data/security review touchpoints, and implementation or transition risk.
You can analyze complex spend, invoice, renewal, usage, and supplier-performance data and use the findings to determine sourcing strategy, stakeholder recommendations, and practical next steps.
You are an effective, influential communicator who can advise stakeholders outside your area of expertise and balance speed, risk, continuity, cost, and governance across Product, Engineering, IT, Security, Finance, Legal, and Accounts Payable.
You have business-level English for global supplier negotiations; Spanish-language fluency is preferred for local collaboration in Mexico City.
You have a bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


About The Team

The Strategic Sourcing team is building category ownership across Crunchyroll's highest-priority supplier areas, including Technology, Marketing, and Operations/Localization. The team partners across the business to improve supplier strategy, contract discipline, purchase-order coverage, renewal readiness, supplier performance, and commercial value without slowing business execution. This role will serve as the primary sourcing partner for Technology stakeholders and will coordinate with other category leads where suppliers span multiple areas of the business.

 

About Our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value


Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves. 
Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding. 
Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.
Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others. 


Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

About the job

Somos un sello discográfico independiente enfocado en impulsar el talento y conectar la música con su audiencia global. Buscamos a un Label Data Analyst analítico, apasionado por la industria musical y con la habilidad de transformar métricas de streaming en estrategias reales de crecimiento.




Objetivos del puesto.




El Analista es responsable de extraer, procesar y evaluar las métricas de rendimiento de los nuevos lanzamientos y del catálogo musical del roster. Su meta principal es proveer insights y reportes estadísticos al equipo de Management para optimizar la toma de decisiones, identificar tendencias de consumo y evaluar el retorno de inversión de las campañas digitales.




Funciones Principales.




• Apoyo en la extracción y recopilación de las métricas de streaming, consumo y engagement de las distintas plataformas (DSPs) y redes sociales.

• Apoyo en el diseño y actualización de reportes de rendimiento para el equipo interno, traduciendo números en gráficos claros y conclusiones accionables.

• Apoyo en la elaboración de la estrategia a partir de los datos y reportes de rendimiento.

• Apoyo en el monitoreo y comportamiento de las listas de reproducción (playlists) y el impacto numérico de las activaciones con influencers o marcas aliadas.

• Evaluar el comportamiento histórico de las canciones del sello para identificar picos de consumo espontáneos o ventanas de oportunidad para reactivar temas antiguos.

• Registro de los gastos de las campañas y contrastarlos con el rendimiento de las reproducciones para calcular la eficiencia del presupuesto invertido.

• Controlar, registrar y asegurar la liquidación de forma exacta las obligaciones por regalías. Garantiza que los pagos a creadores, socios o licenciatarios cumplan las reglas de los contratos vigentes y las normas contables de la empresa.




Perfil del Puesto (Requisitos).




• Educación: Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Publicidad, Comunicación, Administración de Empresas de Entretenimiento o carreras afines. 

• Idiomas: Inglés alto (lectura de reportes globales y documentación técnica).

• Experiencia: 1 año en análisis de datos, business intelligence o marketing digital cuantitativo. Es un plus haber trabajado en sellos, agregadoras, agencias de entretenimiento o sectores afines.

• Conocimiento técnico: Conocimiento de herramientas analíticas de música (Spotify for Artists, Apple Music for Artists, Chartmetric, YouTube Analytics, Meta Business Suite).

• Habilidades analíticas: Manejo intermedio de Excel/Google Sheets (tablas dinámicas, fórmulas lógicas, cruce de bases de datos) y visualizadores de datos.




Ofrecemos: 

Sueldo de acuerdo a nivel de experiencia. 
100% Presencial.

About the job

Technical Customer Support, Support Sr. (Printing Specialist)

Overview:

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.




Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.




You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.




Come make an impact every day at Zebra.




What We're Looking For:

This role is responsible for driving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency by resolving complex, escalated technical issues across our industrial, mobile, and RFID printing portfolios. Utilizing deep hardware and software expertise, the successful candidate will diagnose complex print engine failures, address high-tier calibration challenges, and ensure maximum uptime for critical business environments. Additionally, you will maintain standard-setting response times and proactively contribute to the continuous improvement of the Technical Support Team’s printing diagnostic tools and processes.

Advanced Hardware & Software Troubleshooting

Hardware Maintenance: Expertly diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair print engines, label printers, and mobile printing units to significantly reduce customer downtime.
System Calibration: Configure menus, test sensors, and perform precise printhead adjustments to ensure optimal barcode and RFID readability.
Software Integration: Utilize industry-leading tools, including Zebra Setup Utilities and ZebraDesigner, for seamless device configuration and custom label design.

Customer Success & Escalation Management

Serve as the primary escalation point for resolving highly complex, diverse technical issues that require deep data analysis and critical thinking.
Deliver exceptional technical support to customers via telephone, email, and chat, demonstrating active listening and empathy in high-pressure situations.
Translate highly technical concepts into simple, easy-to-understand terms for both customers and internal management.

Leadership & Process Improvement

Act as a mentor and escalation point to support and guide less experienced agents on the team.
Develop, refine, and improve support processes, tools, and platform developments to enhance the overall customer experience.
Analyze data and prepare detailed reports on the effectiveness and efficiency of the support center.
Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors, internal technical teams, business leaders, and technology partners.

What We Are Looking For:

Education: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent vocational qualification/experience in a related technical field.
Experience: 4 to 5 years of proven experience in technical support, with a strong emphasis on hardware maintenance (printing devices, RFID, and mobile technology highly preferred).
Technical Proficiency: Full understanding of job-related procedures and intermediate to advanced skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to provide clear, concise information using proper professional language.
Core Competencies:
Strong customer service orientation with a dedication to resolving issues effectively.
Solid professional work behaviors (attendance, teamwork, time management).
Advanced problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate moderately complex factors.
Intermediate to advanced skills in task delegation and follow-up.

Why Join Us?

We offer a collaborative environment where your technical expertise is valued, and your career growth is supported. Help us keep the world's supply chains, hospitals, and retail floors running smoothly.




Benefits:

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.




Job Posting Statement:

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people.

description:
About the job

Before you apply to a job, select your language preference from the options available at the top right of this page.

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

Job Description

Together, we are Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics. As the clinical and advanced therapy part of UPS Healthcare, we reach patients faster, with greater scalability and access to new pathways throughout the supply chain. With our One UPS advantage and comprehensive service portfolio, including Polar Speed's in-network pharmacies, we are optimally positioned to keep our clients competitive in an increasingly complex market.

Job Summary

The Customer Relations Specialist is responsible for handling and processing UPS customers' complaints about package delivery problems (i.e., missing and damaged items) and service failures (i.e., missed deliveries). He/She handles and processes customers' issues and complaint phone calls (i.e., calls to UPS Corporate Headquarters, Global Business Services, and UPS telephone package line), emails, faxes, and letters. This position is responsible for handling calls originally directed to UPS senior management and Management Committee members, managing the resolution process and reporting back to UPS senior management and Management Committee members on issue and complaint resolutions. The Customer Relations Specialist utilizes customer information databases to build customers' complaint profiles, summarizes and highlights customers' issues, and determines UPS location responsibility (e.g., District Managers, Operations Centers, etc.) for resolving customers' issues. This position interacts with UPS corporate departments (i.e., Public Relations, Legal, and Security) to ensure departments are notified of customers' issues and develop reports for Customer Relations and UPS senior management, summarizing customers' issues and resolutions. He/She acts diplomatically to handle calls from VIPs and diffuses and stabilizes calls from frustrated customers. This position processes correspondence from attorneys and states' attorneys general to ensure requests, demands, and inquiries are processed correctly within established deadlines.

Employee Type

Permanent

UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

Permanente

de negocio.

Comportamiento de los pú

Somos más que un lugar de trabajo: construimos y vivimos diariamente el Ecosistema Bien Estar Bien, basado en la relación armoniosa entre cada individuo, las relaciones a su alrededor y el entorno en el que está inmerso. description:
About the job

Our team is looking for a strong media buyer who has experience managing $50,000 USD per month (or more) 




This is NOT your typical media buyer role where as an agency we get compensated a % of ad spend for big brands 




We are spending OUR money to send traffic to various lead generation offers and are paid a FIXED Pay Per Lead or Pay Per Sale. This means if we get paid $50 per lead and your cost per lead is $60, we lose money as a company, where the opposite means we are profitable if your cost per lead is $40 then we profit $10 per lead. 




This will require someone who 

Has extensive experience managing and optimizing campaigns on META 
Can take full responsibility for the performance of the account 
Can read and interpret KPIs and data to understand performance 
Knows and understands how to optimize campaigns, targeting, manual bidding, creatives etc. to hit target costs consistently 




You’ll receive a base salary to start, if you can prove performance then you’ll be eligible for potential bonuses etc. based on performance 




To be considered, write a 2-3 paragraph response explaining why you believe you’d be the perfect person for this role and what you will do that’s unique and separate you from most media buyers. IF you meet any of the BONUSES below, note these in an additional paragraph 




BONUS: Some things that will make you stand out as a candidate

The higher the average monthly spend you’ve managed, the better
Your experience testing unorthodox methods with duplicating campaigns, bid cap methods etc. to hit targets 
Experience with ad tracking platforms such as hyros, voluum, clickflare, redtrack etc 

 • • Knowing how to pass all data points via subids and then being able to interpret that data to optimize for deeper funnel objectives

Buscamos un Buying Executive que sera responsable de gestionar el proceso de compra de medios end-to-end, brindando soporte operativo y administrativo para garantizar la correcta ejecución de campañas publicitarias en medios digitales y tradicionales.

La persona ideal contará con experiencia en compra de medios, seguimiento de campañas y gestión de proveedores, destacando por su atención al detalle, organización y capacidad para coordinar múltiples procesos simultáneamente.




Principales actividades

Gestionar la compra de medios digitales y tradicionales.
Generar y administrar órdenes de compra dentro de los sistemas internos.
Dar seguimiento a campañas publicitarias y monitorear indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs).
Coordinarse con equipos internos y proveedores para garantizar la correcta implementación de campañas.
Gestionar conciliaciones, órdenes finales y procesos de facturación.
Dar seguimiento a materiales, testigos, recolocaciones y documentación relacionada con campañas.
Validar que toda la información esté correctamente cargada en los sistemas internos.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de fechas de cierre administrativo y financiero.
Administrar la relación operativa con proveedores y dar seguimiento a incidencias.




Requisitos

Licenciatura concluida en Mercadotecnia, Administración, Relaciones Comerciales o afín.
Mínimo 1 año de experiencia en compra de medios dentro de una agencia de medios.
Conocimiento de medios digitales y tradicionales.
Experiencia trabajando con:
Medios Digitales (formatos, plataformas y terminología).
TV Abierta, TV de Paga, Radio, OOH y Cine.
Manejo intermedio o avanzado de Excel (tablas dinámicas, filtros y análisis de información).
Experiencia utilizando Advertmind.
Conocimiento de herramientas como HR Media y Auditsa (deseable).
Inglés intermedio deseable.

description:
About the job

Executive Growth Strategy, Enterprise Scaling & Full Funnel Leadership

📍 Guadalajara, Jalisco, México

🏢 Executive On-Site | 👥 Executive Oversight of Global Growth Operations

Help Build the Growth Behind the Mission

At FLF, transformative growth requires executive strategy, visionary leadership, and disciplined capital allocation. As our California personal injury law firm continues to scale across key markets, we require a proven executive marketing leader to architect our overall acquisition strategy, diversify our brand channels, and optimize profitability.

We are seeking an experienced Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) to serve on our executive leadership team. Operating from our Guadalajara regional hub, you will take full strategic responsibility for our brand equity, enterprise growth strategy, dollar ad spend allocation, and cross-functional performance across marketing and intake operations.

Why This Role Matters

As our Chief Marketing Officer, you will serve as the top growth authority responsible for defining, executing, and scaling FLF's macro marketing roadmap. You will provide strategic leadership for our regional marketing operations (including our 8-person GDL team), agency networks, and media-buying infrastructure.

Working directly with the Managing Partners, Chief Executive Leadership, and Operational Heads, you will align performance marketing, brand positioning, traditional media investments, and call center intake funnel efficiency to maximize firm revenue and Cost Per Retained Case (CPRC). Your executive direction will directly shape FLF’s expansion as a premier California legal brand.

Compensation & Benefits


Base Compensation in USD based on experience, paid twice a month
Executive Bonus
C-suite executive leadership role shaping firm-wide strategic growth
Significant media budget authority across digital, TV, radio, and billboard channels
Direct oversight of nearshore operational hub and agency partnerships
Executive retreat opportunities, professional development, and industry leadership platforms
State-of-the-art executive offices in Guadalajara's premier financial district (Midtown Jalisco)


What You'll Do

Executive Marketing Strategy & P&L Ownership


Architect and execute the firm’s comprehensive growth strategy to capture market share across target California DMAs.
Manage total marketing P&L, allocating multi-channel media budgets across Digital Paid Media (Google Search, LSAs, Meta), TV, Radio, Billboards, and Community Relations.
Drive enterprise performance based on executive yield metrics: Cost Per Retained Case (CPRC), Average Case Value yield, and overall Marketing Return on Investment (ROAS/ROI).
Identify competitive vulnerabilities, emerging media channels, and strategic expansion opportunities across new practice areas or territories.


Brand Development & Integrated Media Management


Elevate FLF’s brand architecture, positioning, storytelling, and market presence across all consumer touchpoints.
Oversee large-scale traditional media acquisitions (Broadcast TV, Connected TV, Terrestrial/Digital Radio, OOH) to complement digital direct-response campaigns.
Maintain consistent executive messaging and brand authority across digital assets, mass media advertising, and community outreach.


Growth Operations & Organizational Leadership


Provide top-level executive leadership and mentoring to the Head of Marketing, 8-person regional marketing team, and external agency partners.
Architect the scalable organizational structure required to support multi-regional firm growth.
Establish high-level department SLAs, executive scorecards, and cross-departmental accountability frameworks.


Cross-Functional Revenue Funnel Leadership


Partner with Executive Leadership and Intake Management to optimize the complete conversion lifecycle—from first ad click to signed retainer agreement.
Lead enterprise business intelligence initiatives using Power BI, Looker Studio, and legal analytics platforms to guide firm-wide decision-making.
Serve as the chief authority on California State Bar legal advertising compliance (Rules 7.1–7.3), safeguarding firm reputation and licensing standards.


What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Master's / MBA preferred.
Minimum 10 + years of executive marketing leadership (CMO, VP of Marketing, Growth Director) with demonstrated success scaling high-volume direct-response organizations.
Proven track record managing annual media budgets across both digital (Search, Paid Social) and mass traditional media (TV, Radio, Billboard).
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise growth teams, agency partners, and nearshore/offshore operational centers.
Mastery over financial acquisition metrics in high-CPL industries: Cost Per Retained Case (CPRC), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Return on Equity/Ad Spend, and attribution modeling.
Native or near-native professional English fluency with exceptional C-suite communication, negotiation, and board-level presentation skills.


Preferred Qualifications


Extensive executive background in high-volume Personal Injury law, legal services, or mass-scale legal lead generation.
Deep understanding of California media markets, DMA dynamics, and California State Bar advertising ethics.
Experience integrating advanced AI platforms, predictive analytics, and automated lead routing into marketing engines.


The Type of Person Who Thrives Here

Our Most Successful Executive Leaders Are


Visionary Growth Executives: Strategic thinkers who balance high-level vision with aggressive business execution
P&L Controllers: Financial-minded marketers who treat media budget allocation like an investment portfolio
Inspirational Leaders: Executives who build powerful workplace cultures and elevate team performance
Legal Industry Authority: Leaders who understand how to win in hyper-competitive legal advertising markets


Why Join FLF?

As CMO at FLF, you will sit at the steering wheel of a rapidly scaling legal organization. You will leverage significant capital, cutting-edge nearshore infrastructure in Guadalajara, and aggressive strategic positioning to build a dominant legal brand in California. If you are an executive ready to make a high-stakes impact, we invite you to lead our expansion.

Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?


Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

Stripe is investing in building out its Global Professional Services team to actively engage all customers from Fortune 100s to startups to help accelerate their adoption of Stripe capabilities. The team is responsible for ensuring that our customers deploy quickly with high quality integrations. It then partners closely with front line developers and technical leaders to ensure our customers continue to derive strategic value from Stripe and grow with us as our respective product portfolio expands. In addition, as we master the craft of deployment services, help build the asset and strategy that will enable us to scale through our partner ecosystem.

The Stripe Accelerate is a 3-month offering that unlocks access to a team of Stripe experts to help the user through every step of the implementation. This is included as part of Stripe solution, at no extra cost to our users. Accelerate Onboarding Managers provide prescriptive guidance and planning for the user’s onboarding journey. Onboarding Specialists provide product workshops, best practices, regular check-ins, and technical Q&A. This offering is targeted at Startup and SMB users.

A Few Key Features Of Accelerate Include


Specialized experts: Accelerate experts provide experience helping customers integrate Stripe technology in thousands of projects.
Project management consists of a kick off call, regular check-ins, email Q&A to help unblock your team.
Product workshops and training for fraud and dashboard



What you’ll do

The Onboarding Specialist is responsible for providing technical guidance to users during their onboarding journey with Stripe. They proactively address technical queries, troubleshoot issues, and provide solutions to ensure a seamless onboarding process. They work closely with users to understand their needs, offer guidance on best practices, and anticipate and address any potential technical challenges. The Onboarding Specialist collaborates with cross-functional teams, escalates issues as needed, and maintains accurate records of user interactions. Their goal is to provide exceptional customer service and ensure that users have a positive and successful onboarding experience with Stripe.

Responsibilities


Proactively providing technical guidance and support to users during their onboarding journey with Stripe.
Deliver pre-built technical workshops and kick off calls to users.
Provide light touch project management for ongoing Stripe implementations and timely escalate any delays with planned go-live dates.
Troubleshooting technical issues and providing timely solutions to ensure a smooth onboarding process.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to address user queries and concerns.
Maintaining accurate records of user interactions, issues, and resolutions.
Anticipating and addressing potential technical challenges during the onboarding process. Proactively propose improvements.
Offering guidance on best practices, product features, and account setup to ensure user success.
Continuously updating knowledge of Stripe's products, features, and updates.
Escalating complex technical issues to appropriate teams for resolution.
Providing exceptional customer service to ensure a positive onboarding experience for users.
Contributing to the improvement of onboarding processes and documentation.



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Advanced English proficiency- fluent in written and spoken.
2+ years of implementation consulting in API technologies or other complex technical environments.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Strong technical understanding of APIs and experience with SaaS solutions.
Comfortable talking about technical concepts, and explaining how Stripe works, both from a product features and API architecture perspective.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to effectively engage and influence various stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience working with financial systems, online payments, or e-commerce platforms.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
Experience delivering live technical training to users.
Comfortable with various code-level debugging & writing of code.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

About the job

Descripción de la empresa Agrosur es una empresa agroindustrial mexicana con más de 15 años de experiencia generando inversiones en los sectores agrícola y ganadero. Nos enfocamos en proyectos sostenibles que impulsan la productividad del campo y la competitividad de la cadena alimentaria. Colaboramos con productorxs y aliadxs estratégicxs para mejorar procesos, calidad y rendimientos. Como parte de nuestra expansión, estamos potenciando el área de procesado de miel para llegar a nuevos mercados nacionales e internacionales.

También analizarás indicadores de producción, propondrás mejoras en procesos y colaborarás con otras áreas como logística, compras y calidad. description:
About the job

About Us

Placement International is a global leader in luxury hospitality cultural exchange programs. We specialize in offering highly educated students and young professionals paid internships, management training programs, and first-time job opportunities in the most prestigious hotels and restaurants across the United States and worldwide.




With over ten years of experience, we have built a strong international network within the hospitality industry, partnering with high-end properties, leading global hotel chains, and Michelin-starred chefs. We don’t just offer internships, we create high-value, career-defining international experiences.




Job Summary: Sales Representative (Placement Specialist)

As a Placement Specialist, you are the engine of our sales funnel. Your goal is simple: Convert high-potential talent into successful international placements. You will manage a pipeline of Mexican hospitality students, acting as a persuasive consultant who overcomes objections, builds urgency, and closes the deal. This role is ideal for a results-oriented professional who is motivated by achieving targets, and recognizes the impact that successfully placing a candidate can have on their career.




The Sales-Driven Requirements

Sales DNA: 1-3 years of experience in high-volume Sales, Recruitment, or Business Development with a proven "closer" track record.
The "Closer" Mentality: You are resilient, competitive, and motivated by exceeding monthly revenue and placement targets.
Market Expertise: A graduate of a top Mexican hospitality program who can leverage their network to build immediate trust.
CRM Mastery: You live in HubSpot/Salesforce. You understand that if it isn't in the CRM, it didn't happen.
Bilingual Persuasion: Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the ability to pitch to both a student and a C-level Hotel Director.




Your High-Impact Responsibilities

1. Pipeline Velocity & Lead Conversion

Lead Management: Rapidly qualify and convert inbound leads from Mexican universities into active program applicants.
Consultative Closing: Use deep industry knowledge to overcome candidate objections regarding visas, costs, and relocation, moving them through the funnel with urgency.
Sale Ownership: Take full responsibility for the "Sale-to-Payment" cycle, ensuring all program fees are collected on time.




2. Strategic Growth & Market Penetration

Network Expansion: Proactively "hunt" for new talent by building relationships with career centers at Mexico’s elite hospitality schools.
Pitch Mastery: Host high-energy webinars and on-campus recruitment events designed to generate "on-the-spot" sign-ups and applications.
Brand Authority: Position Placement International as the only premium choice for luxury placements programs in the Mexican market.




3. Data Integrity & CRM Excellence

Funnel Hygiene: Maintain a pristine CRM database, ensuring every interaction is logged and every candidate is nurtured through automated and manual touchpoints.
Conversion Optimization: Analyze your own sales data to identify where candidates are dropping off and implement strategies to plug the "leaks" in your funnel.




4. Data-Driven Decision Making

Analytics: Use CRM data to identify bottlenecks in the recruitment process and implement immediate sales solutions.
Reporting: Deliver clear, performance-based reports to leadership regarding the Mexican market’s growth and ROI.




Why Join Us?

This isn't a desk job; it’s a career-making opportunity. You will have the autonomy to shape the Mexican market, the thrill of hitting high-level targets, and the satisfaction of seeing your candidates thrive in the world’s best hotels. At Placement International, we reward ambition, celebrate wins, and offer a truly global work environment.




Ready to build the future of hospitality? Apply now.
